```{r}
#| label: load-packages
#| echo: false

pacman::p_load(haven, patchwork, ggtext, gt, install = FALSE)
source(here("custom_func/theme_main_fig.R"))
```

## Overview

Reviewer R1.3 asked for a diagram of when cognitive status was assessed: dementia was captured over a mean of 8.8 years (maximum 13.4), whereas MCI was assessed only at baseline and about 5 years later. This notebook computes the timing numbers for the 2,491 analyzed participants, draws the new Supplementary Figure S1 and drafts its legend.

Outputs (all in `demographics/output/`, prefix `followup_timeline_`):

- `followup_timeline_group_numbers.rds`: per-group n, AGES-II attendance and status, follow-up time and dementia-surveillance time;
- `followup_timeline_subcategories.rds`: AGES-II subcategories and dementia ascertainment sources;
- `followup_timeline_calendar.rds`: study calendar and overall follow-up;
- `followup_timeline_figure.rds` and `followup_timeline_figure.png`: Figure S1 (180 mm wide, 600 dpi).

## Load data

The analyzed sample, the dementia categories and the AGES-I/AGES-II visit records come from three files. They are joined on the subject ID, case-insensitively.

### Analyzed participants

The 2,496 participants in the EWAS input file. The 5 with missing smoking status are dropped later, after the submitted Table 1 has been reproduced on all 2,496.

```{r}
#| label: read-analyzed

analyzed <-
  read_rds(here("data/collaborator_only/covariates_and_meth_DMP_on_chr21.rds")) |>
  dplyr::select(subr_id18, a1smokingstatus, dementia_ages1_eos) |>
  mutate(subr_id18 = tolower(as.character(subr_id18)))

glimpse(analyzed)
```

### Dementia categories

The collaborator's dementia-category file. `time_in_days` is the time from the AGES-I visit to incident dementia, death or censoring, and is 0 for prevalent dementia.

```{r}
#| label: read-dementia-cat

dem_cat <-
  read_rds(here("data/collaborator_only/covariate_dementia_cat.rds")) |>
  dplyr::select(subr_id18, demcat, time_in_days, in_ages2) |>
  mutate(subr_id18 = tolower(as.character(subr_id18)))

glimpse(dem_cat)
```

### AGES-I and AGES-II visit records

The AGES-I visit date, the AGES-I to AGES-II interval, the AGES-II cognitive status and the source of each dementia diagnosis. `A2COGSTATNEW` is coded 0 normal, 1 MCI, 2 demented, 3 missing classification, 4 not in AGES-II and 5 demented without subtype.

```{r}
#| label: read-visits

visits <-
  read_sas(here("data/collaborator_only/rai_a1a2cogstat2016_jan2017_reva.sas7bdat")) |>
  transmute(
    subr_id18 = tolower(SUBR_ID18),
    date_ages1 = BOOKDATE_IC,
    days_ages1_to_ages2 = DAYS_AGES_AGESII,
    status_ages2 = as.numeric(A2COGSTATNEW),
    in_ages2_visits = as.numeric(in_ages2),
    date_end_surveillance = most_recent_fup_date,
    days_to_death = DAYS_AGES_IC_TO_DEATH,
    dementia_source,
    dementia_rai_source
  )

glimpse(visits)
```

### Merge

The six groups carry the collaborator's numeric codes (`AGES_DEMENTIA`), which the follow-up rule below refers to. Every participant must match a visit record, and the two group labels and two AGES-II flags must agree.

```{r}
#| label: merge

group_codes <- tibble(
  group = c("stable_normal", "normal2mci", "normal2incid", "stable_mci", "mci2incid", "prev"),
  ages_dementia = c(0, 1, 2, 4, 5, 6)
)

timeline_2496 <-
  analyzed |>
  inner_join(dem_cat, by = "subr_id18") |>
  left_join(visits, by = "subr_id18") |>
  mutate(group = as.character(dementia_ages1_eos)) |>
  left_join(group_codes, by = "group") |>
  mutate(
    date_ages2 = date_ages1 + days_ages1_to_ages2,
    date_end = date_ages1 + time_in_days
  )

stopifnot(
  nrow(timeline_2496) == 2496,
  !anyNA(timeline_2496$date_ages1),
  !anyNA(timeline_2496$ages_dementia),
  all(str_replace(as.character(timeline_2496$demcat), "prev_dementia", "prev") == timeline_2496$group),
  all(timeline_2496$in_ages2 == timeline_2496$in_ages2_visits),
  all(!is.na(timeline_2496$days_ages1_to_ages2) == (timeline_2496$in_ages2 == 1))
)

timeline_2496 |> count(ages_dementia, group)
```

## Follow-up time definition

The collaborator's follow-up variable (`FU_DAYS` in `AGES_Dementia_Status_Jun2025.sas`) is `time_in_days`, except for normal2mci and stable_mci participants who attended AGES-II, where it is the AGES-I to AGES-II interval. Prevalent dementia therefore has 0.

### Reproduce the submitted Table 1

The submitted Table 1 printed values computed on 2,496 participants. Reproducing them exactly confirms the rule.

```{r}
#| label: fu-days-2496

days_per_year <- 365.25

timeline_2496 <-
  timeline_2496 |>
  mutate(
    fu_days = if_else(ages_dementia %in% c(1, 4) & in_ages2 == 1, days_ages1_to_ages2, time_in_days)
  )

table1_submitted <- tribble(
  ~group, ~fu_days_mean_submitted, ~fu_days_sd_submitted,
  "stable_normal", 3869, 773,
  "normal2mci", 1921, 139,
  "stable_mci", 2104, 1020,
  "normal2incid", 2730, 905,
  "mci2incid", 2239, 720,
  "prev", 0, 0
)

fu_check_2496 <-
  timeline_2496 |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    fu_days_mean = round(mean(fu_days, na.rm = TRUE)),
    fu_days_sd = round(sd(fu_days, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .by = group
  ) |>
  left_join(table1_submitted, by = "group")

stopifnot(
  all(fu_check_2496$fu_days_mean == fu_check_2496$fu_days_mean_submitted),
  all(fu_check_2496$fu_days_sd == fu_check_2496$fu_days_sd_submitted)
)

fu_check_2496
```

### Analyzed sample

Drop the 5 participants with missing smoking status to leave the 2,491 used in every EWAS model.

```{r}
#| label: analyzed-2491

timeline <- timeline_2496 |> dplyr::filter(!is.na(a1smokingstatus))

stopifnot(nrow(timeline) == 2491)
```

## Study calendar

The calendar range of each exam, the AGES-I to AGES-II interval, and the end of record-based surveillance.

```{r}
#| label: calendar

calendar <-
  timeline |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    ages1_first = min(date_ages1, na.rm = TRUE),
    ages1_median = median(date_ages1, na.rm = TRUE),
    ages1_last = max(date_ages1, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_ages2 = sum(in_ages2 == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    ages2_first = min(date_ages2, na.rm = TRUE),
    ages2_median = median(date_ages2, na.rm = TRUE),
    ages2_last = max(date_ages2, na.rm = TRUE),
    interval_days_p05 = quantile(days_ages1_to_ages2, 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    interval_days_median = median(days_ages1_to_ages2, na.rm = TRUE),
    interval_days_p95 = quantile(days_ages1_to_ages2, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE),
    surveillance_end_first = min(date_end_surveillance, na.rm = TRUE),
    surveillance_end_last = max(date_end_surveillance, na.rm = TRUE),
    latest_event = max(date_end, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  mutate(across(starts_with("interval_days"), \(x) x / days_per_year, .names = "{str_replace(.col, 'days', 'years')}"))

stopifnot(
  calendar$surveillance_end_first == calendar$surveillance_end_last,
  calendar$latest_event <= calendar$surveillance_end_last
)

calendar |> pivot_longer(everything(), values_transform = as.character)
```

AGES-I visits ran from `r calendar$ages1_first` to `r calendar$ages1_last`. The `r scales::comma(calendar$n_ages2)` participants who attended AGES-II were seen from `r calendar$ages2_first` to `r calendar$ages2_last`, a median `r sprintf("%.2f", calendar$interval_years_median)` years later (5th–95th percentiles `r sprintf("%.2f", calendar$interval_years_p05)`–`r sprintf("%.2f", calendar$interval_years_p95)`). Record-based surveillance ended on `r calendar$surveillance_end_last` for every participant; no follow-up ends after that date.

## Per-group numbers

For each group: AGES-II attendance and status, the Table 1 follow-up (`fu_days`), and the dementia-surveillance time (`time_in_days`, to dementia, death or end of surveillance). `end_*` counts how each participant's surveillance ended.

```{r}
#| label: group-numbers

group_order <- c("stable_normal", "normal2mci", "stable_mci", "normal2incid", "mci2incid", "prev")
group_names <- c(
  stable_normal = "Stable normal",
  normal2mci = "Normal to MCI",
  stable_mci = "Stable MCI",
  normal2incid = "Normal to incident dementia",
  mci2incid = "MCI to incident dementia",
  prev = "Prevalent dementia"
)

timeline <-
  timeline |>
  mutate(
    end_reason = case_when(
      group == "prev" ~ "baseline",
      group %in% c("normal2incid", "mci2incid") ~ "dementia",
      date_end == date_end_surveillance ~ "end_of_surveillance",
      !is.na(days_to_death) & time_in_days == days_to_death ~ "death"
    )
  )

stopifnot(!anyNA(timeline$end_reason))

group_numbers <-
  timeline |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    n_ages2 = sum(in_ages2 == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_ages2_normal = sum(status_ages2 == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_ages2_mci = sum(status_ages2 == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_ages2_dementia = sum(status_ages2 %in% c(2, 5), na.rm = TRUE),
    n_ages2_unclassified = sum(status_ages2 == 3, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_not_ages2 = sum(in_ages2 == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    fu_days_mean = mean(fu_days, na.rm = TRUE),
    fu_days_sd = sd(fu_days, na.rm = TRUE),
    surv_days_mean = mean(time_in_days, na.rm = TRUE),
    surv_days_sd = sd(time_in_days, na.rm = TRUE),
    surv_days_median = median(time_in_days, na.rm = TRUE),
    surv_days_max = max(time_in_days, na.rm = TRUE),
    end_dementia = sum(end_reason == "dementia", na.rm = TRUE),
    end_death = sum(end_reason == "death", na.rm = TRUE),
    end_of_surveillance = sum(end_reason == "end_of_surveillance", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_dx_ages2_exam = sum(dementia_source == "IHA", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_dx_records = sum(dementia_source %in% c("RAI", "MOR"), na.rm = TRUE),
    dx_date_p05 = quantile(date_end, 0.05, type = 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    dx_date_median = quantile(date_end, 0.50, type = 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    dx_date_p95 = quantile(date_end, 0.95, type = 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    .by = c(group, ages_dementia)
  ) |>
  left_join(table1_submitted, by = "group") |>
  mutate(
    group = factor(group, levels = group_order),
    group_name = group_names[as.character(group)],
    across(c(fu_days_mean, fu_days_sd, surv_days_mean, surv_days_sd, surv_days_median, surv_days_max),
           \(x) x / days_per_year, .names = "{str_replace(.col, 'days', 'years')}"),
    fu_definition = case_when(
      group == "stable_normal" ~ "to death or end of surveillance",
      group == "normal2mci" ~ "AGES-I to AGES-II interval",
      group == "stable_mci" ~ "AGES-I to AGES-II interval if attended, else to death or end of surveillance",
      group %in% c("normal2incid", "mci2incid") ~ "to dementia diagnosis",
      group == "prev" ~ "none (dementia at baseline)"
    ),
    across(starts_with("dx_date"), \(x) if_else(group %in% c("normal2incid", "mci2incid"), x, as.Date(NA))),
    across(starts_with("n_dx_"), \(x) if_else(group %in% c("normal2incid", "mci2incid"), x, NA_integer_))
  ) |>
  arrange(group) |>
  relocate(group_name, .after = group)

# The legend says dementia surveillance continued after AGES-II for the normal2mci and
# stable_mci participants who attended it, although their Table 1 follow-up stops there.
mci_attenders <- timeline |> dplyr::filter(group %in% c("normal2mci", "stable_mci"), in_ages2 == 1)

stopifnot(
  sum(group_numbers$n) == 2491,
  all(mci_attenders$time_in_days > mci_attenders$days_ages1_to_ages2),
  all(with(group_numbers, n_ages2 + n_not_ages2 == n)),
  all(with(group_numbers, n_ages2_normal + n_ages2_mci + n_ages2_dementia + n_ages2_unclassified == n_ages2))
)
```

The submitted Table 1 printed follow-up computed on 2,496 participants; the analyzed sample is 2,491. The change per group, both in whole days after rounding as Table 1 does and unrounded:

```{r}
#| label: fu-change

fu_exact_2496 <- timeline_2496 |> summarise(mean_exact_submitted = mean(fu_days, na.rm = TRUE), .by = group)

fu_change <-
  group_numbers |>
  transmute(
    group = as.character(group),
    mean_submitted = fu_days_mean_submitted,
    mean_2491 = round(fu_days_mean),
    mean_change = mean_2491 - mean_submitted,
    mean_exact_2491 = fu_days_mean,
    sd_submitted = fu_days_sd_submitted,
    sd_2491 = round(fu_days_sd),
    sd_change = sd_2491 - sd_submitted
  ) |>
  left_join(fu_exact_2496, by = "group") |>
  mutate(mean_exact_change = mean_exact_2491 - mean_exact_submitted) |>
  relocate(mean_exact_submitted, .before = mean_exact_2491)

fu_changed <- fu_change |> dplyr::filter(mean_change != 0 | sd_change != 0)

# The prose below names exactly these two groups and says both means move by less than
# their rounded values; the unrounded 2,496 means must round to the submitted values.
stopifnot(
  setequal(fu_changed$group, c("stable_normal", "normal2incid")),
  all(round(fu_change$mean_exact_submitted) == fu_change$mean_submitted),
  all(abs(fu_changed$mean_exact_change) < abs(fu_changed$mean_change))
)

fu_of <- function(g, col, accuracy = 1) scales::comma(fu_change[[col]][fu_change$group == g], accuracy = accuracy)
days_text <- function(g, col, accuracy = 1) {
  x <- fu_change[[col]][fu_change$group == g]
  glue("{scales::comma(x, accuracy = accuracy)} {if (abs(x) == 1) 'day' else 'days'}")
}

fu_change
```

Only two groups change, and both means move by less than their rounded values suggest. stable_normal's rounded mean moves by `r days_text("stable_normal", "mean_change")` (`r fu_of("stable_normal", "mean_submitted")` to `r fu_of("stable_normal", "mean_2491")`; unrounded `r fu_of("stable_normal", "mean_exact_submitted", 0.1)` to `r fu_of("stable_normal", "mean_exact_2491", 0.1)`, a change of `r days_text("stable_normal", "mean_exact_change", 0.1)`) and its SD by `r days_text("stable_normal", "sd_change")` (`r fu_of("stable_normal", "sd_submitted")` to `r fu_of("stable_normal", "sd_2491")`). normal2incid's rounded mean moves by `r days_text("normal2incid", "mean_change")` (`r fu_of("normal2incid", "mean_submitted")` to `r fu_of("normal2incid", "mean_2491")`; unrounded `r fu_of("normal2incid", "mean_exact_submitted", 0.1)` to `r fu_of("normal2incid", "mean_exact_2491", 0.1)`, a change of `r days_text("normal2incid", "mean_exact_change", 0.1)`) and its SD by `r days_text("normal2incid", "sd_change")` (`r fu_of("normal2incid", "sd_submitted")` to `r fu_of("normal2incid", "sd_2491")`). The table below shows the 2,491 values next to the submitted ones.

```{r}
#| label: group-numbers-table

group_numbers |>
  dplyr::select(group_name, n, n_ages2, n_ages2_normal, n_ages2_mci, n_ages2_dementia,
                n_ages2_unclassified, fu_days_mean, fu_days_sd, fu_days_mean_submitted,
                fu_days_sd_submitted, fu_years_mean, fu_years_sd, surv_years_mean,
                surv_years_sd, surv_years_max, end_dementia, end_death, end_of_surveillance) |>
  gt(rowname_col = "group_name") |>
  fmt_number(columns = c(fu_days_mean, fu_days_sd, fu_days_mean_submitted, fu_days_sd_submitted), decimals = 0) |>
  fmt_number(columns = ends_with(c("years_mean", "years_sd", "years_max")), decimals = 1) |>
  tab_spanner("AGES-II status", columns = starts_with("n_ages2_")) |>
  tab_spanner("Table 1 FU, days (2,491)", columns = c(fu_days_mean, fu_days_sd)) |>
  tab_spanner("Submitted (2,496)", columns = ends_with("_submitted")) |>
  tab_spanner("Table 1 FU, years", columns = c(fu_years_mean, fu_years_sd)) |>
  tab_spanner("Surveillance, years", columns = starts_with("surv_years")) |>
  tab_spanner("Surveillance ended by", columns = starts_with("end_")) |>
  cols_label(
    n_ages2 = "AGES-II", n_ages2_normal = "normal", n_ages2_mci = "MCI",
    n_ages2_dementia = "dementia", n_ages2_unclassified = "unclassified",
    fu_days_mean = "mean", fu_days_sd = "SD", fu_days_mean_submitted = "mean",
    fu_days_sd_submitted = "SD", fu_years_mean = "mean", fu_years_sd = "SD",
    surv_years_mean = "mean", surv_years_sd = "SD", surv_years_max = "max",
    end_dementia = "dementia", end_death = "death", end_of_surveillance = "Oct 2015"
  ) |>
  tab_options(table.font.size = px(12))
```

## Overall follow-up

The mean and maximum of the Table 1 follow-up across all 2,491, and the same without the 161 prevalent cases (who contribute 0) and as dementia-surveillance time.

```{r}
#| label: overall-followup

overall <-
  timeline |>
  summarise(
    fu_years_mean_all = mean(fu_days, na.rm = TRUE) / days_per_year,
    fu_years_max_all = max(fu_days, na.rm = TRUE) / days_per_year,
    fu_years_mean_no_prev = mean(fu_days[group != "prev"], na.rm = TRUE) / days_per_year,
    surv_years_mean_no_prev = mean(time_in_days[group != "prev"], na.rm = TRUE) / days_per_year,
    surv_years_max = max(time_in_days, na.rm = TRUE) / days_per_year,
    n_at_risk = sum(group != "prev", na.rm = TRUE)
  )

calendar <- bind_cols(calendar, overall)

overall
```

The manuscript's "mean 8.8 years" is the mean Table 1 follow-up over all 2,491 (`r sprintf("%.2f", overall$fu_years_mean_all)` y), which counts the 161 prevalent cases at 0 and the normal2mci and stable_mci AGES-II attenders at their AGES-I to AGES-II interval. Without the prevalent cases the mean is `r sprintf("%.2f", overall$fu_years_mean_no_prev)` y. The mean dementia-surveillance time of the `r scales::comma(overall$n_at_risk)` participants at risk is `r sprintf("%.2f", overall$surv_years_mean_no_prev)` y. The maximum is `r sprintf("%.2f", overall$fu_years_max_all)` y.

## Subcategories

How each incident and MCI group splits by AGES-II attendance and status, and where each incident dementia diagnosis came from: IHA is the AGES-II exam, RAI the nursing-home (NH) or home-care (HC) assessments, and MOR the death certificate.

```{r}
#| label: subcategories

ages2_split <-
  timeline |>
  dplyr::filter(group %in% c("normal2incid", "mci2incid", "stable_mci")) |>
  mutate(
    subcategory = case_when(
      in_ages2 == 0 ~ "did not attend AGES-II",
      status_ages2 %in% c(2, 5) ~ "dementia diagnosed at AGES-II",
      status_ages2 == 1 & group == "stable_mci" ~ "MCI at AGES-II",
      status_ages2 == 1 ~ "MCI at AGES-II, then dementia",
      status_ages2 == 0 ~ "normal at AGES-II, then dementia",
      status_ages2 == 3 ~ "attended AGES-II, unclassified, then dementia"
    )
  ) |>
  count(group, subcategory, name = "n") |>
  mutate(split = "AGES-II attendance and status")

dx_source <-
  timeline |>
  dplyr::filter(group %in% c("normal2incid", "mci2incid")) |>
  mutate(
    subcategory = case_when(
      dementia_source == "IHA" ~ "AGES-II exam",
      dementia_source == "RAI" & dementia_rai_source == "NH" ~ "nursing-home assessment",
      dementia_source == "RAI" & dementia_rai_source == "HC" ~ "home-care assessment",
      dementia_source == "MOR" ~ "death certificate"
    )
  ) |>
  count(group, subcategory, name = "n") |>
  mutate(split = "dementia ascertainment source")

subcategories <-
  bind_rows(ages2_split, dx_source) |>
  mutate(group = factor(group, levels = group_order)) |>
  arrange(split, group, desc(n)) |>
  relocate(split)

stopifnot(
  !anyNA(subcategories$subcategory),
  sum(ages2_split$n) == sum(group_numbers$n[group_numbers$group %in% c("normal2incid", "mci2incid", "stable_mci")]),
  sum(dx_source$n) == sum(group_numbers$n[group_numbers$group %in% c("normal2incid", "mci2incid")])
)

subcategories |> gt(groupname_col = "split") |> tab_options(table.font.size = px(12))
```

Every dementia case diagnosed at AGES-II is also dated on or before the AGES-II visit, so the exam status and the diagnosis date agree.

```{r}
#| label: check-ages2-dementia

ages2_dementia_check <-
  timeline |>
  dplyr::filter(group %in% c("normal2incid", "mci2incid"), in_ages2 == 1) |>
  count(group, dementia_at_ages2 = status_ages2 == 2, dated_by_ages2 = time_in_days <= days_ages1_to_ages2)

stopifnot(all(with(ages2_dementia_check, dementia_at_ages2 == dated_by_ages2)))

ages2_dementia_check
```

## Figure S1

Calendar time on the x-axis, the two exam windows shaded, record-based surveillance as a bar, and one row per transition group showing its cognitive status at AGES-I, the AGES-II status that established the group and, for the incident groups, when dementia was diagnosed. A right-hand column gives how many in each group were assigned at AGES-II and how many from records, and how its Table 1 follow-up time is defined.

### Plot data

Positions for every layer: exam windows run from the first to the last visit and status labels sit at the median visit date. Each group shows one AGES-II status, the one that established it (normal for stable_normal, MCI for normal2mci and stable_mci, dementia for the incident groups); the other participants were assigned from records, by the absence of a recorded dementia diagnosis in the stable groups and by a recorded diagnosis in the incident groups. prev_dementia was established at AGES-I, so it has no AGES-II label. Rows with a two-line split in the right-hand column, and the incident rows with their red span of dementia-diagnosis dates (5th–95th percentiles), are taller.

```{r}
#| label: plot-data

fmt_y <- function(x) sprintf("%.1f", x)
incident_groups <- c("normal2incid", "mci2incid")
stable_groups <- c("stable_normal", "stable_mci")
status_levels <- c("Normal", "MCI", "Dementia")
status_words <- c(Normal = "normal", MCI = "MCI", Dementia = "dementia")
defining_status <- c(
  stable_normal = "Normal", normal2mci = "MCI", stable_mci = "MCI",
  normal2incid = "Dementia", mci2incid = "Dementia", prev = NA
)
row_heights <- c(
  stable_normal = 1.2, normal2mci = 1, stable_mci = 1.2,
  normal2incid = 1.3, mci2incid = 1.3, prev = 0.8
)
span_offset <- 0.35

# Row labels use the group codes as Table 1 prints them, except that prevalent dementia
# is spelled out as "prev_dementia" (response-list decision 36); `group` keeps "prev".
plot_groups <-
  group_numbers |>
  mutate(
    group = as.character(group),
    group_label = if_else(group == "prev", "prev_dementia", group),
    row = as.character(glue("{group_label}<br>(n = {scales::comma(n)})")),
    height = row_heights[group],
    status_ages2 = defining_status[group],
    n_from_ages2 = case_when(
      status_ages2 == "Normal" ~ n_ages2_normal,
      status_ages2 == "MCI" ~ n_ages2_mci,
      status_ages2 == "Dementia" ~ n_ages2_dementia
    ),
    n_from_records = n - n_from_ages2,
    from_ages2 = glue("From AGES-II: {scales::comma(n_from_ages2)} {status_words[status_ages2]}"),
    from_records = case_when(
      group %in% stable_groups ~ glue("From records: {scales::comma(n_from_records)} dementia-free"),
      group %in% incident_groups ~ glue("From records: {scales::comma(n_from_records)} dementia")
    ),
    fu = glue("{fmt_y(fu_years_mean)} ({fmt_y(fu_years_sd)}) years"),
    note = case_when(
      group == "stable_normal" ~ glue("{from_ages2}\n{from_records}\nFollow-up to death or end of surveillance:\n{fu}"),
      group == "normal2mci" ~ glue("{from_ages2}\nFollow-up from AGES-I to AGES-II:\n{fu}"),
      group == "stable_mci" ~ glue(
        "{from_ages2}\n{from_records}\nFollow-up to AGES-II if attended, else to\n",
        "death or end of surveillance: {fu}"
      ),
      group %in% incident_groups ~ glue("{from_ages2}\n{from_records}\nFollow-up to dementia diagnosis:\n{fu}"),
      group == "prev" ~ glue("No follow-up (dementia at baseline): 0 years")
    )
  )

# The two counts must add up to each group. In the incident groups they are the AGES-II and
# record sources of the dementia diagnosis. The stable groups had no other status at AGES-II,
# so their records share is everyone not classified there: non-attendees plus attendees
# without a classification. Every normal2mci participant was classified at AGES-II.
incident_split <- plot_groups |> dplyr::filter(group %in% incident_groups)
stable_split <- plot_groups |> dplyr::filter(group %in% stable_groups)

stopifnot(
  !anyNA(plot_groups$note),
  all(incident_split$n_from_ages2 == incident_split$n_dx_ages2_exam),
  all(incident_split$n_from_records == incident_split$n_dx_records),
  all(stable_split$n_from_records == stable_split$n_not_ages2 + stable_split$n_ages2_unclassified),
  plot_groups$n_from_records[plot_groups$group == "normal2mci"] == 0
)

# Each row has a height and the centres stack from the bottom. The study-design rows are
# offset by 100 so that none of their y breaks falls inside the groups panel.
design_rows <- tibble(
  row = c("AGES-I exam", "AGES-II exam", "Dementia<br>surveillance"),
  height = 1,
  section = "Study design"
)

layout_rows <- function(d, offset) {
  d |> mutate(top = offset + rev(cumsum(rev(height))), y = top - height / 2, bottom = top - height)
}

rows <-
  bind_rows(
    layout_rows(design_rows, 100),
    layout_rows(plot_groups |> transmute(row, height, section = "Transition group"), 0)
  ) |>
  mutate(section = factor(section, levels = c("Study design", "Transition group")))

add_rows <- function(d) {
  d |>
    mutate(
      row = as.character(row),
      y = rows$y[match(row, rows$row)],
      section = rows$section[match(row, rows$row)]
    )
}

panel_extents <-
  rows |>
  summarise(ymin = min(bottom, na.rm = TRUE), ymax = max(top, na.rm = TRUE), .by = section) |>
  pivot_longer(c(ymin, ymax), values_to = "y")

exam_windows <- tibble(
  xmin = c(calendar$ages1_first, calendar$ages2_first),
  xmax = c(calendar$ages1_last, calendar$ages2_last)
)

design_bars <-
  tibble(
    row = design_rows$row,
    xmin = c(calendar$ages1_first, calendar$ages2_first, calendar$ages1_first),
    xmax = c(calendar$ages1_last, calendar$ages2_last, calendar$surveillance_end_last),
    fill = c("grey78", "grey78", "#F4CBC6"),
    text_colour = c("black", "black", "#7A1F19"),
    label = c(
      glue("{year(calendar$ages1_first)}–{year(calendar$ages1_last)}"),
      glue("{year(calendar$ages2_first)}–{year(calendar$ages2_last)}"),
      glue("Record-based surveillance to {format(calendar$surveillance_end_last, '%e %b %Y') |> str_squish()}")
    )
  ) |>
  add_rows()

# The AGES-II status that established each group, one label per row, on the row's line.
ages2_status <-
  plot_groups |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(status_ages2)) |>
  transmute(group, status = status_ages2, n = n_from_ages2)

# The incident-group dementia counts must match the AGES-II split in the subcategories table.
incident_status_check <-
  subcategories |>
  dplyr::filter(split == "AGES-II attendance and status", subcategory == "dementia diagnosed at AGES-II") |>
  transmute(group = as.character(group), n_sub = n) |>
  inner_join(ages2_status, by = "group")

stopifnot(
  setequal(incident_status_check$group, incident_groups),
  all(incident_status_check$n_sub == incident_status_check$n)
)

status_labels <-
  bind_rows(
    tibble(
      group = c("stable_normal", "normal2mci", "stable_mci", "normal2incid", "mci2incid", "prev"),
      status = c("Normal", "Normal", "MCI", "Normal", "MCI", "Dementia"),
      label = status,
      x = calendar$ages1_median
    ),
    ages2_status |>
      transmute(group, status, label = glue("{status} ({scales::comma(n)})"), x = calendar$ages2_median)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    row = plot_groups$row[match(group, plot_groups$group)],
    status = factor(status, levels = status_levels)
  ) |>
  add_rows()

surveillance_lines <-
  plot_groups |>
  dplyr::filter(group != "prev") |>
  transmute(row, xmin = calendar$ages1_median, xmax = calendar$surveillance_end_last) |>
  add_rows()

no_dementia <-
  plot_groups |>
  dplyr::filter(group %in% c("stable_normal", "normal2mci", "stable_mci")) |>
  transmute(row, x = as.Date("2013-03-01"), label = "No dementia recorded") |>
  add_rows()

dementia_spans <-
  plot_groups |>
  dplyr::filter(group %in% incident_groups) |>
  transmute(row, dx_date_p05, dx_date_median, dx_date_p95) |>
  add_rows() |>
  mutate(y = y - span_offset)

notes <-
  bind_rows(
    tibble(
      row = design_rows$row,
      note = c(
        glue("Blood draw ({scales::comma(calendar$n)} analyzed); cognition\nclassified as normal, MCI or dementia"),
        glue(
          "A median {fmt_y(calendar$interval_years_median)} years after AGES-I; cognition\n",
          "classified as normal, MCI or dementia"
        ),
        "Nursing-home and home-care assessments,\ndeath certificates; dementia only (not MCI)"
      )
    ),
    plot_groups |> transmute(row, note)
  ) |>
  add_rows()
```

### Draw

Two aligned panels joined with patchwork: the timeline and the notes column. Text sizes are set so that nothing prints below 6.5 pt where the figure is shown smallest, in the supplementary PDF.

```{r}
#| label: draw-figure
#| fig-width: 7.09
#| fig-height: 5.31

# The PNG is drawn 180 mm wide, but ms/fig_tbl/supplementary_figures.qmd places every
# figure at width = 100% of its 6.0 in (152.4 mm) text block, i.e. at 0.847 of its drawn
# size. Text is sized for that placement, so nothing prints below 6.5 pt there.
fig_width_mm <- 180
fig_height_mm <- 135
placed_width_mm <- 152.4
min_print_pt <- 6.5
text_pt <- ceiling(10 * min_print_pt * fig_width_mm / placed_width_mm) / 10
axis_pt <- text_pt + 0.5
title_pt <- text_pt + 1

status_fill <- c(Normal = "#DCEAF6", MCI = "#FBE3B8", Dementia = "#F4CBC6")
status_line <- c(Normal = "#2C6BA0", MCI = "#A86400", Dementia = "#A8312A")
dementia_colour <- "#A8312A"
facet_rows <- facet_grid(section ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y", switch = "y")
y_rows <- scale_y_continuous(breaks = rows$y, labels = rows$row, expand = expansion(0))

p_timeline <-
  ggplot(panel_extents, aes(y = y)) +
  geom_blank() +
  geom_rect(data = exam_windows, aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
            fill = "grey93", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = calendar$surveillance_end_last, linetype = "22",
             colour = dementia_colour, linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_tile(data = design_bars,
            aes(x = xmin + (xmax - xmin) / 2, width = as.numeric(xmax - xmin), y = y, fill = I(fill)),
            height = 0.55) +
  geom_text(data = design_bars,
            aes(x = xmin + (xmax - xmin) / 2, y = y, label = label, colour = I(text_colour)),
            size = text_pt, size.unit = "pt") +
  geom_segment(data = surveillance_lines, aes(x = xmin, xend = xmax, y = y, yend = y),
               colour = "grey55", linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_segment(data = dementia_spans, aes(x = dx_date_p05, xend = dx_date_p95, y = y, yend = y),
               colour = dementia_colour, linewidth = 1.3) +
  geom_point(data = dementia_spans, aes(x = dx_date_median, y = y),
             shape = 21, fill = "white", colour = dementia_colour, size = 1.3, stroke = 0.6) +
  geom_text(data = dementia_spans, aes(x = dx_date_p05 - 60, y = y), label = "Dementia diagnoses",
            hjust = 1, size = text_pt, size.unit = "pt", colour = dementia_colour, fontface = "italic") +
  geom_text(data = no_dementia, aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
            nudge_y = 0.17, vjust = 0, size = text_pt, size.unit = "pt",
            colour = "grey35", fontface = "italic") +
  geom_label(data = status_labels,
             aes(x = x, y = y, label = label, fill = status, colour = status),
             size = text_pt, size.unit = "pt", linewidth = 0.3,
             label.padding = unit(1.6, "pt"), label.r = unit(1.5, "pt")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = status_fill, guide = "none") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = status_line, guide = "none") +
  scale_x_date(
    limits = as.Date(c("2002-01-01", "2016-01-01")),
    breaks = seq(as.Date("2002-01-01"), as.Date("2016-01-01"), by = "2 years"),
    date_labels = "%Y", expand = expansion(0)
  ) +
  y_rows +
  facet_rows +
  labs(x = "Calendar year", y = NULL) +
  theme_main_fig(base_size = title_pt) +
  theme(
    strip.placement = "outside",
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text.y.left = element_text(size = title_pt, angle = 90, face = "bold"),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    axis.line.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = ggtext::element_markdown(size = axis_pt, colour = "black"),
    axis.text.y = ggtext::element_markdown(size = axis_pt, colour = "black", hjust = 1, lineheight = 1.1),
    panel.spacing.y = unit(3, "mm"),
    plot.margin = margin(2, 1, 2, 2, "mm")
  )

p_notes <-
  ggplot(panel_extents, aes(y = y)) +
  geom_blank() +
  geom_text(data = notes, aes(x = 0, y = y, label = note),
            hjust = 0, size = text_pt, size.unit = "pt", lineheight = 0.95) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = expansion(0)) +
  y_rows +
  facet_rows +
  theme_void(base_size = title_pt) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing.y = unit(3, "mm"),
    plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 1, "mm")
  )

fig_followup_timeline <- p_timeline + p_notes + plot_layout(widths = c(1.6, 1))

fig_followup_timeline
```

## Save outputs

The per-group numbers, subcategories, calendar, figure object and a 600-dpi PNG at `r fig_width_mm` × `r fig_height_mm` mm.

```{r}
#| label: save

fs::dir_create(here("demographics/output"))

group_numbers |> write_rds(here("demographics/output/followup_timeline_group_numbers.rds"))
subcategories |> write_rds(here("demographics/output/followup_timeline_subcategories.rds"))
calendar |> write_rds(here("demographics/output/followup_timeline_calendar.rds"))
fig_followup_timeline |> write_rds(here("demographics/output/followup_timeline_figure.rds"))

# grDevices::png (cairo) is the device behind most manuscript figures (Figures 1-4 and 6
# and most supplementary figures); it draws `sans` as Nimbus Sans, a Helvetica-metric face.
# Figure 5 and the two pathway supplementary composites use ragg (Noto Sans) instead.
ggsave(
  here("demographics/output/followup_timeline_figure.png"),
  fig_followup_timeline,
  width = fig_width_mm, height = fig_height_mm, units = "mm", dpi = 600, bg = "white",
  device = grDevices::png
)
```

## Draft legend for Figure S1

The proposed legend, in the format of the other supplementary legends in `ms/fig_tbl/supplementary_figures.qmd` (bold title sentence, then a plain description). In that file the opening label becomes the cross-reference `**[@suppfig-followup-timeline]** |`; the numbers below are inline R from this notebook.

**Figure S1** | **Timing of cognitive assessments and dementia ascertainment in the six transition groups.** Upper panel: the AGES-I baseline examination (`r format(calendar$ages1_first, "%B %Y")` to `r format(calendar$ages1_last, "%B %Y")`), at which blood was drawn for DNA methylation and cognition was classified as normal, mild cognitive impairment (MCI) or dementia; the AGES-II examination (`r format(calendar$ages2_first, "%B %Y")` to `r format(calendar$ages2_last, "%B %Y")`, a median of `r fmt_y(calendar$interval_years_median)` years after AGES-I), attended by `r scales::comma(calendar$n_ages2)` of the `r scales::comma(calendar$n)` participants, at which cognition was classified again; and record-based dementia surveillance (nursing-home and home-care assessments, death certificates), which recorded dementia but not MCI and, for every participant without dementia at AGES-I, continued until dementia, death or `r format(calendar$surveillance_end_last, "%e %B %Y") |> str_squish()` (dashed line). MCI could therefore be identified only at the two examinations, whereas incident dementia was identified at AGES-II or from records. Shaded columns mark the first to last visit of each examination. Lower panel: one row per transition group. Labels give the cognitive status at AGES-I and, with the number of participants, at AGES-II for those whose group was established there. The other participants were assigned at AGES-I (prev_dementia) or from records: by the absence of a recorded dementia diagnosis in stable_normal and stable_mci, and by a recorded diagnosis in normal2incid and mci2incid. Grey lines span the surveillance period (none for prev_dementia); red bars span the 5th to 95th percentiles of the dementia-diagnosis dates (circle, median). The right-hand column gives the numbers assigned at AGES-II and from records, and the follow-up time reported in Table 1, here as mean (SD) in years. That follow-up ends at dementia diagnosis in normal2incid and mci2incid; at death or the end of surveillance in stable_normal; at AGES-II, where MCI was last assessed, in normal2mci and in the stable_mci participants who attended it (at death or the end of surveillance in the others); and it is zero in prev_dementia. Dementia surveillance nevertheless continued after AGES-II for the normal2mci and stable_mci participants who attended it. stable_normal, normal cognition at AGES-I and, if attended, at AGES-II, with no dementia recorded; normal2mci, normal cognition at AGES-I and MCI at AGES-II, with no dementia recorded; stable_mci, MCI at AGES-I and, if attended, at AGES-II, with no dementia recorded; normal2incid and mci2incid, normal cognition or MCI, respectively, at AGES-I followed by incident dementia; prev_dementia, prevalent dementia at AGES-I; n, number of participants; SD, standard deviation; AGES, Age, Gene/Environment Susceptibility-Reykjavik Study.
